title: Warrant: an open protocol and reference tool for evidence-gated software built by AI agents
description:
Warrant is an open protocol, with a reference command-line tool, for software that AI agents build and maintain while the people accountable for it direct it without reading the code. A principal states intent as numbered promises. An examiner runs approved checks, some visible to the builder and some hidden, against an exact snapshot of the code and records the evidence. A deterministic gatekeeper issues a warrant or a denial for each action, such as merge or release. Everything is recorded in an append-only, hash-chained ledger.

The repository was created, and v0.1.0 released, on 24 September 2026. Development was AI-assisted, and the commits carry Co-Authored-By trailers.
